title: Healthcare AI Platform
tagline: End-to-end AI platform for community healthcare and clinical automation
description: End-to-end healthcare AI platform combining Medical LLMs, LangGraph workflows, React Native applications, FastAPI microservices, and Bluetooth-enabled medical device integrations. Designed to streamline community healthcare through patient triage, AI-assisted clinical documentation, intelligent reception, and proactive follow-up workflows.
markdown:
Healthcare AI Automation Suite is a production healthcare platform built to support teleconsultation workflows through AI-driven clinical assistance, backend services, and mobile device integration. I led the engineering of most of the platform's core components, taking features from architecture and implementation through deployment, testing, and continuous production improvements.

The platform includes intelligent patient triage, AI-assisted clinical documentation, encounter summarization, follow-up automation, clinical decision support, document understanding, and conversational healthcare workflows. I engineered reliable AI pipelines that combined structured validation, Medical LLMs, and deterministic safety mechanisms to generate consistent, structured outputs suitable for clinical environments.

Beyond the AI systems, I designed and developed scalable backend services using Python and FastAPI, building modular APIs, shared data models, authentication, request validation, and integrations that supported multiple healthcare workflows and real-time application features.

I also developed significant portions of the Android and React Native application, integrating diagnostic medical devices, secure report generation and exchange, native mobile capabilities, and health worker workflows that enabled seamless communication between connected devices and backend services.

Throughout the project I worked across the complete engineering lifecycle, including architecture, backend development, AI integration, mobile development, cloud deployment, debugging, production optimization, and collaboration with cross-functional teams to transform complex healthcare requirements into production-ready software.

### System Architecture & Ecosystem

![Product Ecosystem Overview](/assets/images/projects/liferythm/Product%20Ecosystem%20Overview.png)
*Figure 1: Product Ecosystem Overview — A high-level overview of the AI-powered healthcare platform I engineered at Liferythm Healthcare. The platform combines intelligent clinical modules including AI Receptionist, Patient Triage, Clinical Notes Assistant, Clinical Decision Support, and Follow-Up Coach with a unified patient record to support end-to-end teleconsultation workflows.*

![End-to-End Engineering Architecture](/assets/images/projects/liferythm/End-to-End%20Engineering%20Architecture.png)
*Figure 2: End-to-End Engineering Architecture — A high-level overview of the engineering architecture behind the Healthcare AI Automation Suite. The platform connects diagnostic devices, mobile applications, scalable backend services, and AI-powered clinical workflows into a unified teleconsultation platform. This illustration highlights the end-to-end engineering approach while intentionally abstracting proprietary implementation details and internal system architecture.*
highlights: Led end-to-end development of core teleconsultation platform features, taking them from architecture to production
Engineered reliable AI pipelines combining Medical LLMs, structured validation, and deterministic safety mechanisms
Designed and built scalable FastAPI backend microservices with shared data models and secure authentication
Developed Android/React Native features, integrating Bluetooth diagnostic SDKs and secure medical report exchanges

title: PokéWorld
tagline: Dreamer-style world models for model-based reinforcement learning
description: Research project exploring Dreamer-style world models for model-based reinforcement learning. Focused on learning latent environment dynamics, improving long-horizon prediction, and reducing compounding errors during imagination rollouts.
markdown:
PokéWorld is an ongoing AI research project exploring the evolution of Model-Based Reinforcement Learning (MBRL) and world models through successive architectural iterations. Using Pokémon Red as a controlled benchmark, the project investigates how learned environment dynamics enable planning, imagination, and decision-making before interacting with the real environment.

The first iteration implements a continuous latent world model inspired by the original World Models architecture, combining convolutional encoders, variational latent representations, GRU-based dynamics, scheduled sampling, and Model Predictive Control (MPC). Evaluation probes achieved 98.7% Map ID prediction accuracy, 1.23 tile localization error, while scheduled sampling reduced long-horizon rollout drift from 10.4 to 3.47 tiles, demonstrating more stable latent imagination.

The second iteration transitions to a Dreamer-inspired Recurrent State-Space Model (RSSM) operating at native Game Boy resolution (160×144). The architecture combines residual CNN encoders, deterministic recurrent dynamics, discrete stochastic latent variables, pixel reconstruction, reward prediction, and continuation prediction to improve long-horizon consistency. The current implementation achieves a validation reconstruction loss of 0.1003 after four training epochs.

Current work extends the project toward hierarchical reinforcement learning and diffusion-inspired world models, investigating increasingly expressive architectures capable of learning, planning, and evaluating policies within imagined environments before deployment in more complex domains.

Rather than reproducing existing papers, PokéWorld serves as a research sandbox for studying the progression of world models from continuous latent dynamics to discrete RSSMs and emerging generative approaches while building reusable infrastructure for experimentation, evaluation, and benchmarking in reinforcement learning.

### Research Overview & Roadmap

![Project Overview & Research Highlights](/assets/images/projects/pokedreamer/Project%20Overview%20%26%20Research%20Highlights.png)
*Figure 1: Project Overview & Research Highlights — Research showcase of the PokéWorld project, exploring the evolution of model-based reinforcement learning through successive world models. It progresses from continuous latent dynamics (VAE + GRU) to Dreamer-style discrete RSSMs and toward diffusion-based world models. The project highlights architectural milestones, evaluation metrics, and a long-term roadmap for learning environment dynamics through imagination before real-world interaction.*

![Research Evolution & Future Roadmap](/assets/images/projects/pokedreamer/Research%20Evolution%20%26%20Future%20Roadmap.png)
*Figure 2: Research Evolution & Future Roadmap — A visual overview of the research progression behind PokéWorld, documenting the transition from foundational world models to modern generative architectures. Each iteration builds upon the previous one by improving latent representations, long-horizon prediction, and planning capabilities, with current work focused on diffusion-based world models and scalable neural game engines inspired by recent advances in model-based reinforcement learning.*
highlights: Built a Recurrent State-Space Model (RSSM) dynamics baseline operating at native Game Boy resolution (160x144)
Evaluated continuous latent dynamics models (VAE+GRU) using model predictive control planners
Achieved 98.7% Map ID prediction accuracy and reduced long-horizon rollout drift from 10.4 to 3.47 tiles
Investigating hierarchical reinforcement learning and diffusion-inspired world models in a custom research sandbox

title: NavDP Sandbox
tagline: Navigation Diffusion Policy extension for omni-directional robotics
description: Academic research fork extending the official Navigation Diffusion Policy (NavDP) framework. Solves simulation-to-reality gaps through custom omni-directional hardware integration and physics optimization.
markdown:
### Sim-to-Real Navigation Diffusion Policies
Deploys diffusion policies trained in simulation environments onto physical three-wheeled LeKiwi omni-directional robots.

### Core Engineering Accomplishments
* **USD Collision Geometry fixes**: Programmatically repaired collision meshes in Nvidia Isaac Sim.
* **Actuator Dynamics Tuning**: Tuning gain schedules to resolve simulation explosions and NaN losses.
* **Multi-View Telemetry**: Built real-time rendering tools for BEV tracking and path evaluation.
highlights: Integrated a custom LeKiwi 3-wheeled omni-directional robot into the pipeline
Programmatically re-engineered and fixed broken USD collision geometries
Resolved NaN simulation explosions via actuator gain and physics tuning
Developed custom multi-perspective tools (BEV/3rd-Person) for path evaluation

title: TradingViewPlus
tagline: TypeScript browser extension for 300+ active traders
description: A major open-source enhancement suite for the TradingView ecosystem, actively used by 300+ traders. Contributing major feature releases, adapter-based support for TradingView-powered platforms, architectural improvements, and ongoing maintenance as a project maintainer.
markdown:
Core maintainer of TradingViewPlus, a widely used open-source TypeScript browser extension that enhances the TradingView platform with advanced trading workflows, customizable hotkeys, UI improvements, and cross-browser compatibility for 300+ active users.

Progressed from community contributor to project maintainer by consistently delivering production-ready features, resolving complex bugs, triaging community issues, reviewing architecture decisions, and coordinating public releases.

Major contributions include designing a multi-platform adapter architecture enabling broker integrations (including DHAN), refactoring the extension's hotkey system into a unified dynamic suppression framework, improving cross-browser compatibility across Chrome, Firefox and Opera, modernizing the build pipeline from Bash scripts to Node.js tooling, and delivering multiple UI, performance, and stability improvements.

Authored and merged more than 20 pull requests while resolving 30+ community issues covering feature development, platform compatibility, release engineering, build tooling, documentation, performance optimization, and bug fixes. Contributed significantly to the v5.0.5 release through architecture refactoring, feature enhancements, release preparation, and changelog management.

Responsibilities extended beyond coding to include issue triage, roadmap discussions, release coordination, regression fixes after TradingView platform updates, community support, and maintaining code quality for a production browser extension used daily by active traders.

As a core maintainer, I contributed architecture improvements, feature development, cross-platform compatibility, issue triage, and long-term maintenance while helping evolve the extension through multiple production releases.*

![Major Contributor — TradingViewPlus v5.0.5 Release](/assets/images/projects/tv-plus/Major%20Contributor%20%20-TradingViewPlus%20v5.0.5%20Release.png)
*Figure 2: Major Contributor — TradingViewPlus v5.0.5 Release — Led a significant portion of the v5.0.5 release by delivering major feature refactors, the unified hotkey system, dynamic suppression engine, build system modernization, UI improvements, compatibility fixes, performance optimizations, and release engineering. title: WakeBot32
tagline: Low-power IoT automation tool with secure remote access
description: A practical, lightweight C++ hardware application utilizing an ESP32 microcontroller. Circumvents the need for heavy local servers by acting as a dedicated, secure bridge for remote PC wake commands.
markdown:
### ESP32-Powered Hardware WOL Gateway
A secure, low-power IoT device acting as a bridge to send remote wake commands to host systems.

### Technical Design
* **C++ Arduino firmware**: Written to manage secure memory allocation and minimize power consumption.
* **Telegram Bot polling**: Polling triggers wake requests directly without opening ports on the local network router.
* **WOL Packet Generation**: Broadcasts custom WOL packets over local subnet masks.
highlights: Engineered robust, low-power ESP32 hardware memory interactions using C++
Implemented a secure, user-authenticated polling bridge utilizing the Telegram API
Constructed and deployed network-level Wake-on-LAN (WOL) magic packets
Designed an automated hardware-reboot architecture to guarantee long-term stability
